title: 第9章 海军怎么建？在线等！
slug: 帝国的崛起全本免费-帝国的崛起最新章节列表
content_zh:
再加上随着列强们新的战舰纷纷下水，德国现有舰队的质量迅速缩水，而且不少战舰也已经到了服役年限，这些老旧的东西甚至出过不少事故。所以即使这个位面俾斯麦依然在位，他也决定好好整备一下帝国的海军了！联邦议会应该不存在什么问题，各个邦国都等着从这次大建中分一杯羹呢。帝国议会通不过怎么办？没关系，大不了解散了重新选一个议会再通过吗。
但是，现在有一个非常严重的问题，那就是海军怎么建设的问题！德国海军初期的发展是非常混乱的，德国人为了自己的安全需要一支强大的岸防铁甲舰舰队来保证海岸线不受侵犯，海外有殖民地需要保护，时不时的还和美帝在萨摩亚搞一些对峙，或者欺负一下欧洲土著什么的。所以他需要一支巡洋舰编队，而德国这个倒霉孩子后来还受到了法国绿水学派的影响，造了一大堆鱼雷艇！
可以这么说，德国舰队的生态结构非常混乱，受到各种思潮的影响，各种无用不好用的东西太多了。到了现在可以用的太少了！铁甲舰落后，无法匹敌各国新式战舰，巡洋舰小儿破，先不说战斗力问题，出勤率都够呛。鱼雷艇被证明并没有法国人吹嘘的那么好。那么现在问题来了，德国海军路在何方？总不能说世界本来没有路，走的人多了就成了路了吧！
现在德国海军和高层也十分纠结，虽然决定要大建了，但是能拿出来的钱还是比较少的。即使历史上威廉二世上台后，有皇帝陛下的支持，有提尔皮茨鞍前马后的奔波，4艘勃兰登堡级战列舰的预算通过也是比较困难的。而现在，海军狂热者威廉还没有上台，主观上现任德意志董事会和首席执政官还没有那么大的决心，拨款自然会比较少。而另外一方面再保险条约还存在，在可以预见的将来，德俄关系还不错。海军近海防御的压力并不大。所以历史上的4艘勃兰登堡级战列舰绝对不会现在出现，有没有钱先不说，至少没需要啊！
不但俾斯麦在海军方面比较外行，德国海军将领在战略方面同样比较模糊，但是他们都注意到一个问题，那就是德国的海外利益需要保护，德国的巡洋舰舰队已经可以用残破不堪来形容，一堆2000来吨的木壳巡洋舰早已经不堪重负。到现在为止，德国和美国还在萨摩亚地区没事搞搞对峙，前几年差点打起来。殖民地那嘎达也不安稳。有的时候需要和某些国家的殖民地舰队交流一下。
所以，首相大人认为应该先更新一下巡洋舰舰队。而刚刚被整饬过的帝国海军部纷纷表示支持首相大人的想法，一方面德国人的海外舰队需求确实压过本土安全的需求，俄国人和英国人是朋友，面对法国人，德国用陆军就可以解决问题了。所以保证殖民地和远洋利益的选择时正确的。而另外一方面，因为钢板事件刚刚过去，海军部剩余的大佬们还噤若寒蝉，哪有胆量和权倾一时的首相对着干？活得不耐烦了？
先造巡洋舰的基调定下来了，然后后面的问题更加头疼！你造什么样的巡洋舰呢？是装巡还是防护巡洋舰？是排水量近万的一等巡洋舰还是4000吨左右的二等巡洋舰？巡洋舰的性能怎么设定呢？火力和防御怎么搞？航速是多少？好吧，这些东西确实要交给设计师去实现，但是你总要定个基调吧？这就好比你出去买东西，你都没说要买什么，商家怎么给你介绍？
海军这边是拿着大把的钞票依然十分迷茫。一场场的讨论会开的热火朝天，但是短时间内还真没有一个结果。而民间同样十分热闹，在某个历史名人的鼓捣下，德意志帝国海军氛围可是要浓厚了很多，从穿越者的角度来看，甚至比后世****的海军热还要强一些，毕竟历史上德国出现过皇帝架空战舰的，后世听说过哪国领导人玩SPS吧..。

content_en:
In addition, as the great powers have launched new warships one after another, the quality of Germany's existing fleet has shrunk rapidly, and many warships have reached the end of their service life. These old things have even had many accidents. So even if Bismarck is still in power in this plane, he has decided to prepare the empire's navy! There shouldn't be any problems with the Federal Parliament. All states are waiting to get a piece of this major construction. What should I do if the Imperial Parliament fails to pass? It doesn't matter, I don't know if it's going to be passed by another parliament if it's broken up.
However, there is a very serious problem now, and that is how to build the navy! The early development of the German Navy was very chaotic. For their own safety, the Germans needed a powerful fleet of coastal defense ironclads to ensure that the coastline was not infringed. There were overseas colonies that needed protection. From time to time, they would engage in confrontations with the American emperor in Samoa, or bully the European natives. So he needed a cruiser formation, and this unlucky kid in Germany was later influenced by the French Green Water School and built a lot of torpedo boats!
It can be said that the ecological structure of the German fleet is very chaotic, affected by various ideological trends, and there are too many useless and difficult-to-use things. There are so few available now! The ironclads were lagging behind and could not compete with the new warships of various countries. The cruisers were shabby. Let alone the issue of combat effectiveness, their attendance rate was terrible. The torpedo boats proved not to be as good as the French had boasted. So now the question is, where is the German navy? It cannot be said that the world has no roads in the first place, but it becomes a road when more people walk on it!
Now the German Navy and senior officials are also very entangled. Although they have decided to build a large-scale building, the money available is still relatively small. Even in history, after William II came to power, with the support of His Majesty the Emperor and Tirpitz running around, it was relatively difficult to pass the budget for the four Brandenburg-class battleships. Now, William, the naval fanatic, has not yet come to power. Subjectively, the current German board of directors and chief executive are not so determined, so the allocation will naturally be relatively small. On the other hand, the reinsurance treaty still exists, and relations between Germany and Russia will be good for the foreseeable future. The pressure on naval offshore defense is not great. Therefore, the four Brandenburg-class battleships in history will never appear now. Let’s not talk about whether there is money or not, at least there is no need!
Not only was Bismarck a layman in the navy, but the German naval generals were also vague in strategy, but they all noticed a problem, that is, Germany's overseas interests needed to be protected. The German cruiser fleet could already be described as dilapidated, and a bunch of 2,000-ton wooden-hulled cruisers were already overwhelmed. Until now, Germany and the United States are still engaged in a standoff in Samoa, and they almost came to war in the past few years. Colonial Nagada was not stable either. Sometimes it is necessary to communicate with the colonial fleets of certain countries.
Therefore, the Prime Minister believes that the cruiser fleet should be updated first. The Imperial Navy, which had just been reorganized, expressed support for the Prime Minister's idea. On the one hand, the Germans' overseas fleet needs indeed outweighed the needs of local security. The Russians and the British were friends. Facing the French, Germany could solve the problem with its army. Therefore, the choice to ensure colonial and ocean-going interests is correct. On the other hand, because the steel plate incident had just passed, the remaining bosses of the Navy were still silent. How could they have the courage to confront the all-powerful Prime Minister? Are you tired of living?
The tone of building a cruiser is set first, and then the problems later become even more headaches! What kind of cruiser are you building? Is it a mounted cruiser or a protected cruiser? Is it a first-class cruiser with a displacement of nearly 10,000 tons or a second-class cruiser with a displacement of about 4,000 tons? How to set the performance of the cruiser? How about firepower and defense? What's the speed? Well, these things really have to be left to the designersImplementation, but you have to set a tone, right? It's like when you go out to buy something and you haven't said what you want to buy, how can the merchant introduce it to you?
The navy is still very confused even though it has a lot of money. Discussions were held in full swing, but there was no result in a short period of time. The people are also very lively. Under the instigation of a certain historical celebrity, the atmosphere of the German Imperial Navy has become much stronger. From the perspective of time travellers, it is even stronger than the naval craze in the world in later generations. After all, in history, there was an emperor's overhead battleship in Germany. Later generations have heard of leaders of other countries playing SPS...
